fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Dirt and grime on the floor of the rear splash well / transom area next to the motor
Scuffing and grime on the lower edge of the outboard cowling
Faded, dull black finish on the outboard cowl and lower unit
Light dirt and wear on the cream seat cushions, especially the pedestal seat tops
Green carpet looks generally clean but shows some dust and matting near the rear deck
Hull side paint and graphics look somewhat dull along the port side
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crestliner Fish Hawk. It looks well kept, and a cleanup of the splash well by the motor plus bringing the faded black on the Johnson cowling back would help it pop in photos. We do pre-sale boat details that come to you, including carpet, seats and hull. Would you like a quote?
